title: listings.search_export
description: Cursor snapshot of every listing document — the backfill/rebuild read of the search seam. Snapshot contract verbatim from stapel_core.comm.projections._iter_snapshot: {cursor, limit} -> {rows, cursor, total}, each row being {key, seq, ...document} with the same document shape listings.search_documents returns and seq in unix milliseconds (comparable with a bus Event.timestamp). The cursor is opaque to the caller (keyset paging on the primary key); a null cursor in the answer means the snapshot is exhausted.

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor from the previous answer; null/absent starts the snapshot.
